guidance.statement: Aiming to grow balance sheet advances in line with the industry at 13% to 15% in FY27.
Targeting reduction of RIDF and mandated deposits to below 5% of Total Assets by fiscal '27.
Structurally aiming to reach NIM range of 3.25% to 3.5% over a 2 to 3 year period.
Confidence on delivering 1% ROA in FY28 with lesser reliance on non-core items.

industry: Financial Services > Banks > Private Sector Bank

operating_notes.text: Total recoveries and upgrades were ₹4,795 Cr in FY26, including >₹1,550 Cr from Security Receipts, with ₹800 Cr to ₹1,000 Cr expected in FY27.
Retail slippages in Q4FY26 were ₹888 Cr, lowest in 9 quarters, with annual gross slippage ratio improving to 1.8%.

Postal ballot closed 24 April 2026: Approved appointment and remuneration of Vinay Muralidhar Tonse as MD & CEO (6 April 2026 to 5 April 2029) and material RPTs with Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation.
Moody's upgraded Yes Bank's long-term foreign and local currency bank deposit ratings to Ba1 from Ba2 and BCA to ba2 from ba3 with a stable outlook.

GST Commissioner (Appeals), Maharashtra confirmed a ₹31.63 Cr penalty and ₹31.63 Cr tax demand (₹63.27 Cr total) for July 2017–June 2018, merely confirming the November 2024 Order-in-Original; bank to appeal.

₹8,415 Cr of AT-1 bonds were written down in March 2020; the Bombay High Court set aside the write-down on 20 January 2023 and the Supreme Court stayed that order on 3 March 2023, pending its final judgment.
Proforma net worth would be ₹46,970 Cr and borrowings ₹86,149 Cr if the AT-1 judgment impact were recognised, against reported ₹53,268 Cr and ₹77,734 Cr.
Capital adequacy ratio (Basel III) was 14.5% at 30 September 2026, down from 15.0% a year earlier and 15.1% in Q1FY27.
The Bank acquired loans of ₹5,485 Cr and sold ₹211 Cr through assignment in H1FY27; it has one subsidiary, YES Securities (India) Limited.
Moody's affirmed Yes Bank's long-term deposit ratings at Ba1 and BCA at ba2 with a stable outlook.
FCNR(B) deposits mobilization reached ₹18,575 Cr and related GIFT City foreign currency loans stood at ₹15,215 Cr in Q2FY27.
ECL implementation opening CET-1 impact estimated at 50-60 bps, largely offset by new Credit Risk guidelines.
Yes Bank stated it retains the right to exercise coupon discretion on its AT-1 Bonds under the Information Memoranda terms.
Axis Trustee issued notice demanding Yes Bank reinstate ₹8,415 Cr AT-1 bonds within 3 days.

timeline.summary: Yes Bank reported Q4FY26 net profit of ₹1,068 Cr (+44.7% YoY) and exited FY26 with a 1.0% RoA, with GNPA improving to 1.3%.
Shareholders approved appointment of Vinay Muralidhar Tonse as MD & CEO (until Apr 2029) and material RPTs with SMBC via postal ballot.
On May 8, 2026, RBI imposed a ₹0.32 Cr penalty on Yes Bank for non-compliance with CKYC identifier norms.
Moody's upgraded Yes Bank's long-term ratings and BCA to Ba1 and ba2 respectively, citing improved funding, asset quality, and governance.

YES Bank Limited hosted 1x1 and group meetings with Millennium Capital Management, Flowering Tree Investment Management, Ambit Investment Advisors, Bandhan AMC, Bajaj Finserv Asset Management, Kshema General Insurance, MK Ventures, UTI Pension Fund, Bajaj Alternate Investment, Damani Family Office, HDFC ERGO General Insurance, Mount Intra Finance, PL Asset Management, ValueQuest Investment Advisors, and 360 ONE Capital/Wealth on May 28, 2026, in Mumbai.
YES Bank Limited hosted Goldman Sachs Asia Financials Corporate Day 2026 on June 1, 2026, with 11 institutions attending virtually without disclosing unpublished price-sensitive information.
Yes Bank released its investor presentation for May 2026 detailing FY26 financial performance, strategic turnaround progress, and digital metrics.
YES Bank Limited hosted an Analyst/Institutional Investors Conference on June 02, 2026, with 8 institutions attending physically or virtually.
Yes Bank Limited hosted Citi India Conference 2026 on June 05, 2026, with institutional investors via physical and virtual meetings in Mumbai.

On 5 June 2026 Yes Bank received a GST Order-in-Appeal from the Maharashtra Commissioner (Appeals) confirming a ₹31.63 Cr penalty (₹63.27 Cr total demand) for July 2017–June 2018, with no new demand created; the bank will appeal.

On 15 October 2026 Yes Bank told the exchanges the Supreme Court had pronounced its judgment on the appeals over the March 2020 write-down of ₹8,415 Cr of AT-1 bonds, and said it was still examining the order copy.

Yes Bank rescheduled its Q2 & H1 FY27 conference call to **October 17, 2026 at 4:00 PM IST**, led by **Vinay M. Tonse (MD & CEO)**, **Manish Jain (Executive Director)**, **Niranjan Banodkar (CFO)**, and **Sunil Parnami (Head IR & Sustainability)**.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): interest earned ₹8,649.54 Cr, net profit ₹1,084.08 Cr.
2026-10-20: Yes Bank clarifies audit opinion on Q2FY26 results
2026-10-20: Moody's reaffirmed Yes Bank's Ba1 deposit ratings and ba2 BCA with a stable outlook.
Yes Bank management held its Q2FY27 earnings call discussing the Supreme Court's AT-1 bond ruling impact and operating trends.
Yes Bank announced it retains the right to exercise coupon discretion on AT-1 bonds following queries on the 18 October 2026 coupon date.
Axis Trustee issued a letter demanding Yes Bank reinstate ₹8,415 Cr AT-1 bonds within 3 days or face contempt proceedings.

watchlist.response: The matter is sub judice and reserved for judgment; actions taken were considered in line with contractual obligations, and the bank will update stakeholders upon the verdict.

status_history.evidence: Supreme Court pronounced its judgment on 15 October 2026; the bank is still examining the order copy and has not stated the outcome or its impact.
Supreme Court on 15 October 2026 upheld the Bombay High Court and dismissed the Bank's appeal on the ₹8,415 Cr AT-1 write-down; impact not yet recognised in books.

watchlist.text: Potential balance sheet impact if Supreme Court gives an adverse ruling on the AT1 bonds write-off case.

status_history.evidence: Management detailed the pro forma financial and capital impacts of the Supreme Court AT-1 bond order during the earnings call.

watchlist.text: Disclosure of the Supreme Court order's financial implications

watchlist.response: Management stated principal reinstatement is a balance sheet reserve shift with no cash outflow; treatment of coupons remains under legal and accounting assessment.

status_history.evidence: Bank informed that it retains coupon discretion under AT-1 bond terms and is evaluating options after the 18 October 2026 due date.

watchlist.text: Potential P&L impact and cash outflow from the reversal and coupon payments of reinstated AT-1 bonds.
